request.state: Review a proposed contract completion for the CanCatch app, with no executed SDK, transport or language runtime. The language already has verified inbound capability schemas, queued delivery, an owner-local D1 admission fence, file finalization, retention and scoped reads. A configured source/key identifies the project; public browser credentials authorize submission without authenticating report truth or readers. Limit encoded input to256KiB; require report identity, message and timestamp; optional bounded trace, environment, release and fingerprint enter a closed schema. Strip prohibited context and URL user-info/query/fragment before storing or grouping. Canonical-JSON SHA256 keys use explicit fingerprint else exception kind plus recognized normalized frames else normalized message; issue keys also include version and environment, while each occurrence keeps release. Source maps are not fetched. Allow at most five minutes future and seven days past, checked on intake and queued processing. Unique reports spend a UTC-day project quota in the same admission as content-bound dedupe receipt/durable work intent. Keyed technical tombstones outlive payload retention and cannot admit expired replays. A202 response certifies persisted work, never successful consumer execution. Trusted health updates carry persistent increasing revisions and nondecreasing counters for accepted,rejected,dropped,processing_failed; conflicting equal revisions reject and missing updates mean unknown. Notification records hold independent delivery status for new issues/regressions; current project disablement blocks unsent alerts, removal prevents data resurrection. CanDo maps its existing std.ErrorsV1 report into the collector adapter, not compiler-specific vendor knowledge. Redaction cannot turn attacker text into trusted data; pinned parsing/redaction fixtures and real tests remain absent. Judge whether these written boundaries cohere.

coherence.instructions: Classify internal agreement among these proposed contracts, including adversarial input and replay/health authority. Distinguish an unimplemented design from proven behavior and retain uncertainty.
